decisions.reason: Fouling detection automation supports the firm's push toward energy recovery from wastewater and fits its automation portfolio, so it is likely kept, though it may be merged with Product C.
The weir dimensioning web tool is cheap to maintain, serves engineering planners, and generates leads for the new flap weirs D and F.
The fouling detection system complements A and the firm's heat-recovery strategy, but its niche market and overlap with A create some risk that it is consolidated or dropped.
A spring-controlled flap weir is close to the core flood-control hardware business, was launched recently, and is supported by the dimensioning tool.
Energy management for water facilities is central to the firm's digital networking and efficiency strategy and meets strong demand from utilities.
The overflow flap gate line has several models and its own web page, which signals a core product the firm is actively promoting.
